_meta.rules: 单篇简化版 GRADE（GRADE 原本对一组证据的某结局评级，此为单篇简化）。起点按问题类型+设计：治疗/危害 RCT=高、观察性=低；预后（GRADE 预后扩展，Iorio 2015 BMJ）队列=高；诊断准确性 横断面/队列=高；诊断/预后病例—对照起点亦为高（设计问题计入偏倚风险）；患病率 观察性=高（JBI 患病率清单）；系统综述按纳入研究的设计与问题定起点（CEBM 等级仅作纳入设计的证据）。降级每项 1 级至极低为止：RoB 2/ROBINS-I/QUADAS-2/QUIPS 总体高风险；AMSTAR 2 总体低/极低；间接性：QUADAS-2 适用性高度关注。原文报告矛盾不单独降级，计入偏倚风险/AMSTAR 2 评定。无任何偏倚风险/AMSTAR 2 裁定者 certainty=待评定，计算值存 provisional。叙述性综述、实验/基础及非临床研究=不适用。指南/共识不评，显示自身推荐强度。 ROBINS-I 总体映射（GRADE，Vibe 裁定 2026-11-04）：Serious 降 1 级，Critical 降 2 级（至极低为止）；JBI 清单不设阈值，总体判断由评审人作出并写明理由；病例报告/病例系列用 JBI 病例系列清单，不用 ROBINS-I；卡片确定性按一句话结论所述结局，多个结局取最低（GRADE 按结局评级）。
_meta.rules_v4_amend_2026-11-04: ROBINS-I 总体映射（GRADE，Vibe 裁定 2026-11-04）：Serious 降 1 级，Critical 降 2 级（至极低为止）；JBI 清单不设阈值，总体判断由评审人作出并写明理由；病例报告/病例系列用 JBI 病例系列清单，不用 ROBINS-I；卡片确定性按一句话结论所述结局，多个结局取最低（GRADE 按结局评级）。
_meta.rules_v4_amend_2026-11-09: RoB 2 “一些担忧”（GRADE/Cochrane Handbook，Vibe 裁定 2026-11-09）：担忧领域会影响主要结局时降一级，并写明理由；否则不降。预后研究的偏倚风险工具用 QUIPS（Cochrane 预后综述），患病率部分仍用 JBI 患病率清单。
_meta.rules_v4_amend_2026-11-09_indirectness: R-down-indirectness-population：研究人群比专题问题宽时，降一级。

rules_v4_amend_2026-11-09_dogAD.R-nodown-bias-toward-null: 偏倚朝向无效不降级：只在退出原因是无效、且用药组退出明显少于对照组时适用；各组都大量缺失时照常降级。
rules_v4_amend_2026-11-09_dogAD.R-down-noninferiority-ITT-CI: 非劣效试验：每项结局分开判定，看组间差值（或检验值）是否落在界值内；写出界值，不算 NNT。
rules_v4_amend_2026-11-09_dogAD.R-SR-body-of-evidence: 系统评价：确定性按证据本身定。综述自己做过 GRADE 的，用它的结果；没做过的，按纳入研究推。综述自身的质量只写在 review_rob_* 里。

quotes.quote: A presumptive diagnosis was made to include one or more of the following: adverse reaction to food, flea allergy, contact allergy, suspected AD or unspecified allergic dermatosis.
A diagnosis of cAD was only allowed in combination with one of the other aetiologies.

The most common presumptive diagnosis was food allergy (41.5%), followed by AD (33.3%, in combination with other aetiologies) and contact allergy (33.3%). Flea allergy was least reported, with only 13.8% of the enrolled cases represented.

For 29.3% of the animals, an allergic component was identified that could not be assigned to any of the pre‐defined categories with the information at hand at the time of enrolment; these were assigned as unspecified allergic dermatitis (in combination or not with any of the other causes).

rob_quotes.quote: Data from 16 control animals and three lokivetmab‐treated dogs were not available because they were withdrawn from the study before D28. All withdrawals were to the result of worsening or lack of improvement of clinical signs of allergic dermatitis.

Four animals (one placebo, three lokivetmab‐treated dogs) received forbidden medication during the study period and as a result their efficacy data were excluded from the D28 dataset. Data from one additional placebo‐treated animal were excluded because the D28 assessment was performed outside of the allowed window (D28 ± 3 days).
